rows.title: Norwegian Police — EU/EEA Registration Requirements
rows.excerpt: EU/EEA nationals who intend to stay in Norway for more than three months must register with the police.

rows.title: Founder case verification — Internal FR-NO walkthrough
rows.excerpt: Appointment slots at Oslo police were fully booked 7 weeks out when we checked on July 10. Booked on Day 1 of arrival to secure a slot within the 3-month window.

rows.title: Skatteetaten — D-number for foreign nationals
rows.excerpt: A D-number is a temporary identification number that is assigned to foreign nationals who are not required to be registered in the National Registry.

rows.title: DNB Bank — Become a customer (English)
rows.excerpt: To open an account with DNB, you will need: valid ID, Norwegian D-number or national identity number, and Norwegian address.

rows.title: UDI — Skilled Workers Permit
rows.excerpt: Processing time for skilled worker applications is normally 1-4 months. Applications from employers with approved fast-track schemes are typically decided within 3-5 weeks.

rows.title: Norwegian Embassy Paris — Visas and Residence Permits
rows.excerpt: Once your permit has been approved by the UDI, you must collect your residence card at this embassy before travelling to Norway.

rows.title: NAV — Employer obligations in Norway
rows.excerpt: Employers must report all employment relationships to the Norwegian Tax Administration via the A-melding scheme before the employee's first working day.
